scientific_limitations: Exact conditional origin-mark law requires an i.i.d. compactly supported strictly positive reset-location law, including the initial starting point, exponential reset clocks and upper thresholds strictly outside the reset support.
The high-rate Gamma boundary-layer assertion requires a density with positive power-law behavior at both support endpoints.
The first high-threshold excursion is not asserted to be the excursion attaining the final exact maximum; no statement is made about the full reset-time path.
title: Exact marked-excursion decoupling and opposite endpoint selection in Brownian resetting
